headline: SIR JIM 🏦 SUSPENDS 🛑 UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 PLANTS 🌱 Over GAS 💨 PRICES
text:
BILLIONAIRE 🧑‍💼 SIR 🦸 JIM 🐀 RATCLIFFE 🚫 is FORCING 🛠️ a HARD 🪨 PAUSE ⏸️ on production 🏭 at his three 🕒 key 🔑 UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 plants 🌱 because natural 🧪 gas 💨 prices 💰 are literally 🔥 TWELVE 1️⃣2️⃣ times ⏳ more expensive 💸 than in the US 🇺🇸!! The industrial 🏗️ giant 🦍 Ineos 🧪 said UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 gas 💨 is also EIGHT 8️⃣ times ⏳ pricier than coal ⚒️ based 🧱 processes used by Chinese 🇨🇳 competitors 🥊, leaving 🍂 Sir 🦸 Jim's 🐀 most efficient 🏆 plants 🌱 in Europe 🌍 getting absolutely COOKED 🍳 by these insane 💥 energy ⚡ costs!! "We are being FORCED 🪢 to mothball 🪦 some of the most efficient 🏆 plants 🌱 in Europe 🌍 but with gas 💨 prices 💰 now 12 1️⃣2️⃣ times ⏳ the level in the US 🇺🇸 and 8️⃣ times ⏳ that of China 🇨🇳 we just cannot compete 🥊" he admitted 🎤 while owning 🏠 Manchester 🏟️ United ⚽ too!! Ineos 🧪 Acetyls 🧪 part of the Ineos 🧪 Group is the ONLY 🥇 European 🌍 producer of key 🗝️ chemicals 🧪 used in everything from food 🍎 and medicines 💊 to explosives 💣 so this suspension 🛑 hits different 😤 and affects up to ONE 🕐 THOUSAND 1️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ staff 👷 of whom 245 work directly at the site!!

The move 🏃 will impact 👊 up to 1️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ of its staff 👷 but the BBC 📺 understands workers 🧑‍🔧 across the sites 🏭 will be kept on payroll 💰 while Sir 🦸 Jim's 🐀 crew tries to buy liquefied 🧊 natural 🧪 gas 💨 directly from the US 🇺🇸 at lower prices 💰 which could take up to a YEAR 📅 or waits for gas 💨 prices 💰 to finally drop 🥀!! Two 🕒 plants 🌱 on the site have already been turned off 🔌 and the third 3️⃣ will follow in coming days 📆 as Sir 🦸 Jim 🐀 the billionaire 🤑 Man 🧔 United ⚽ owner says he has totally LOST 😞 confidence in the UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 after calling it "on the slide" 🛝 blaming high taxes 💸 and high immigration 🚶‍♂️!! Ineos 🧪 is begging governments 🏛️ in the UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 and the EU 🇪🇺 where most of its products 📦 are exported to put in tariff 🛡️ protections against those Chinese 🇨🇳 products 🧪 because one plant 🌱 makes acetic acid 🧪 which is used in vinegar 🥫 paint 🎨 and glue 🩹 another makes acetic anhydride 🧪 a key ingredient of aspirin 💊 and the third makes ethyl acetate 🧪 used as a solvent 🧼 and for decaffeinating ☕ tea 🍵 and coffee!!

Disruption 🌀 of supplies 🚚 of oil 🛢️ and gas 💨 through the Strait of Hormuz after the US 🇺🇸 Israel 🇮🇱 war in Iran 🇮🇷 has pushed prices 💰 around the world 🌍 sky high ☁️ while the wholesale price of natural gas 💨 used for heating homes 🏠 and generating electricity ⚡ has almost DOUBLED 2️⃣ in the UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 and Europe 🌍 since July 🗓️!! Sir 🦸 Jim 🐀 said the current government's energy ⚡ policy is "economic vandalism 🧨 on an industrial scale" and that his plants 🌱 in Humberside are among the most efficient 🏆 in the world 🌍 producing materials with HALF 1️⃣/2️⃣ the carbon footprint 👣 of US 🇺🇸 rivals and only one eighth 1️⃣/8️⃣ the footprint of Chinese 🇨🇳 equivalents!! It's the second time in less than a week that Sir 🦸 Jim 🐀 who also owns a large stake in Manchester 🏟️ United ⚽ has heavily criticised government 🏛️ policy and last week he told BBC 📺 News he has lost confidence in the UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 describing the country as "on the slide" 🛝 which he blamed on high taxes 💸 and high immigration 🚶‍♂️!!

Sir 🦸 Jim 🐀 whose wealth is estimated around 15 1️⃣5️⃣ billion pounds 💷 has prompted controversy in the past with his comments on immigration and he was a supporter of Brexit 🇬🇧 but has been a tax resident in Monaco 🇲🇨 since 2020!! The Department for Business 🏢 Innovation 🧠 Science 🔬 and Trade said it would be a concerning time for workers 🧑‍🔧 in Saltend and their families 👨‍👩‍👧 while a spokesperson added they've taken bold action to support our chemicals 🧪 industry including 350 3️⃣5️⃣0️⃣ million pounds 💷 for strategically important chemicals 🧪 producers which will be available on a co-investment basis!! They've also put trade measures in place on foreign chemicals 🧪 imports and are tackling high electricity ⚡ costs via our Supercharger 🔋 and British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme to keep our chemicals 🧪 sector competitive!!

Ineos 🧪 Acetyls company cut a fifth of its workforce last year citing high energy ⚡ costs and "dirt-cheap" competition from China 🇨🇳 and it called for tariffs 🛡️ or taxes on imports to protect the industry!! This whole saga leaves Sir 🦸 Jim's 🐀 efficient 🏆 plants 🌱 getting mothballed 🪦 like some sad abandoned factory 🏚️ while he sits in Monaco 🇲🇨 flexing that 15 1️⃣5️⃣ billion 💰 fortune and still owning Manchester 🏟️ United ⚽ but hey the Department 🏛️ promises bold moves so maybe the UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 chemicals 🧪 game can still get railed back into shape before everything slides further down the drain!!
